item.tib: dbal gsas rngam pa'i g.yung drung tshe yi sgrub pa
item.coloph: g.yung drung tshe yi sgrub pa legs so/ 'gro rnams 'di la gang spyod pa/ tshe la dbang thob rig 'dzin nyid du 'gyur/ g.yung drung tshe yi sgrub pa shin tu zab pa'i mchog gling gshen nam mkha' mthong gsal gyis/ 'gro ba'i don du yi ger bkod/
